mushroom.notes: two picked brown mushrooms (the drawn nodes' brown kind, mushroom_2 and _3): a big one standing with a crumb of soil on its pulled foot, a small one lying on its side in front, gills and the cut stalk showing. Not stackable today (no stack in data/items.json); the small one reaches the cell's lower right, so a stack count would sit on it.

salt.notes: a small heap of coarse white salt crystals: every grain a tiny block, bright top-left and shaded right, two loose grains at the foot. Not stackable today; the heap fills the cell's bottom, so a stack count would sit on it.
